ELECTRICITY — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #14
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: ELECTRICITY
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When learning DC Generators, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for DC Generators.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for DC Generators.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after DC Generators.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for DC Generators.

2. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun
   B. Ignore burnt cables
   C. Overload every socket
   D. Never touch live wires with wet hands

3. When learning Single Stage Bipolar Junction Transistor Amplifier, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Single Stage Bipolar Junction Transistor Amplifier.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Single Stage Bipolar Junction Transistor Amplifier.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Single Stage Bipolar Junction Transistor Amplifier.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Single Stage Bipolar Junction Transistor Amplifier.

4. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Remove all guards
   B. Wear safety gear and follow instructions
   C. Work alone with eyes closed
   D. Run with the tool

5. When learning Single Phase AC Generators, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Single Phase AC Generators.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Single Phase AC Generators.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Single Phase AC Generators.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Single Phase AC Generators.

6. When learning Measuring Instruments, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Measuring Instruments.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Measuring Instruments.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Measuring Instruments.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Measuring Instruments.

7. When learning Earthing and Excess Current Protection, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Earthing and Excess Current Protection.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Earthing and Excess Current Protection.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Earthing and Excess Current Protection.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Earthing and Excess Current Protection.

8. When learning Electronics 4.4 Project Identification, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Electronics 4.4 Project Identification.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Electronics 4.4 Project Identification.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Electronics 4.4 Project Identification.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Electronics 4.4 Project Identification.

9. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. Monitor
   B. Keyboard
   C. CPU
   D. Speaker

10. When learning Power Supplies, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Power Supplies.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Power Supplies.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Power Supplies.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Power Supplies.

11. When learning Inspection and Testing, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Inspection and Testing.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Inspection and Testing.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Inspection and Testing.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Inspection and Testing.

12. When learning Wiring Systems and Regulations, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Wiring Systems and Regulations.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Wiring Systems and Regulations.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Wiring Systems and Regulations.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Wiring Systems and Regulations.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Introduction to Digital Electronics and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Single Phase AC Circuits and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Orthographic Projection and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Electrical Diagrams and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:
MARKING SCHEME
====

1. D — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for DC Generators.

2. D — Never touch live wires with wet hands

3. C — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Single Stage Bipolar Junction Transistor Amplifier.

4. B — Wear safety gear and follow instructions

5. A — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Single Phase AC Generators.

6. D — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Measuring Instruments.

7. D — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Earthing and Excess Current Protection.

8. C — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Electronics 4.4 Project Identification.

9. C — CPU

10. A — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Power Supplies.

11. C — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Inspection and Testing.

12. B — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Wiring Systems and Regulations.
